items.description: Israel's PM says its military will not pull out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

items.description: The Irish Prison Service bought a bulletproof and bombproof van to transport the 49-year-old to court after his extradition from Dubai.

items.title: Ancient Roman shipwreck discovered off Sicily coast
items.description: Italy's culture minister says it is one of the most important underwater archaeological finds in years.

items.title: Residents warned to brace for the worst as Canada wildfire rages out of control
items.description: The Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia, still considered "out of control", has spread over 53 sq miles (136 sq km).

items.title: Ecuador charges ex-minister over presidential candidate assassination case
items.description: Prosecutors accuse six others, including the leader of cartel Los Lobos, of having an indirect role in the murder of Fernando Villavicencio.

items.title: Drones spotted over German base days after Leipzig bomb incident
items.description: Police are investigating a drone sighting over a miltary base reportedly used for housing Patriot missile system parts.

items.title: Nigerian army says it safely rescued 33 people kidnapped by gunmen
items.description: The people were abducted while travelling through the country's north-western Zamfara state on Saturday.

items.title: Perez Hilton faces long recovery after reports he self-harmed during livestream
items.description: The US blogger is in a "serious but stable" condition in hospital, according to his family.

items.title: Puerto Rico rations water supplies due to intense drought
items.description: Hot weather and ageing infrastructure have led to the rationing, affecting hundreds of thousands of people.

items.title: An unbearable rotting stench is plaguing an LA neighbourhood
items.description: Heaps of rotting meat have been festering in the summer sun after a fire ripped through a huge food warehouse.

items.title: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
items.description: Israel is planning large-scale land expropriations in historic, Palestinian areas of the West Bank.

items.title: Man arrested after boat capsizes near Statue of Liberty killing woman and infant
items.description: Twelve other people initially rescued from the water are all reported to be in stable condition.
